description:
From running barefoot in Ethiopia to becoming one of the greatest athletes in history, this vlog is about the incredible journey of Haile Gebrselassie 🇪🇹

A true legend who didn’t only inspire the world through athletics, but also changed thousands of lives through business, tourism, and job creation in Ethiopia.

🏨 Haile now owns 11 resorts across Ethiopia, with 2 more opening soon.  
👥 Over 3,500 people have work opportunities through his businesses.  
🔥 His story proves that success is not only about winning races — it’s about uplifting a nation.

In this vlog, we explore the legacy, achievements, and impact of one of Ethiopia’s greatest icons. From world records to building opportunities for the next generation, Haile Gebrselassie continues to inspire millions around the world.

Watch till the end and don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more inspiring Ethiopian stories and travel vlogs!
